messages.subject: geom_forecast in the forecast package
parts:
I wanted to replicate Rob Hyndman's ggplot2 graphics example using geom_forecast in the forecast package namely:

WWWusage %>% auto.arima %>% forecast(level=c(50,80,95)) -> fc

autoplot(WWWusage) +

geom_forecast(fc, color=’#ffcccc’, show.legend=FALSE) +

ggtitle("Forecasts from ARIMA model") +

labs(x="Minute", y="Number of users")


Changing the show.legend option to show.legend=TRUE does not reveal the legend. Is there a big here? Thanks.
